blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Mix 1 scoop daily with 8-10 ounces of water or the beverage of your choice. For best results, use a blender-type bottle or shaker cup. Best when taken as directed by a qualified healthcare professional.
Note: 5 grams per scoop is an average. Individual scooping technique may yield slightly less than or slightly more than 5 grams
